# Test fixtures

- `readsb-sample.jsonl`: synthetic readsb JSON-port output, generated by
  `gen_readsb_jsonl.py` (see its docstring).
- `raw/`: real receiver captures, used by `test_rawtools.sh` and handy for
  `skycue-start.sh replay-raw`. They are third-party data, committed unchanged
  under their own licences; this repository is private and does not
  redistribute them. Do not ship them in release bundles.
- `fisb/`: FIS-B uplink test data (fisb-decode's `tg30.978`, and
  `received-with-uplinks.jsonl` generated by `fisb/gen_received_with_uplinks.py`), used by
  the `test_fisb_*` tests; origin, licence and contents in `fisb/README.md`.

## raw/modes-120s.csv.gz

- Origin: https://github.com/junzis/pyModeS, file
  `scripts/data/airsquitter_2026-07-13_120s.csv.gz` (renamed here).
- Licence: GPL-3.0 (the pyModeS repository's licence).
- Content: 120 s of 1090 MHz Mode S traffic (European, 2026-07-13), 176,612
  messages (118,059 short, 14 hex digits; 58,553 long, 28 hex digits); readsb
  decodes positions for 248 aircraft from it.
- Line format: `epoch_seconds.fraction,HEX`, no header, gzip-compressed.
  First line: `1783963099.005369,5F406A936F50F0`.
- Decoding positions needs a receiver location near the traffic, e.g.
  `--lat 52.0 --lon 4.5 --max-range 500` for readsb.
- sha256: `fa433eb8dc2ec9cf6ebd40c1bf0a095ae753960d5e8c42ae6da15cc28eb3baea`

## raw/uat-sample.txt.gz

- Origin: https://github.com/flightaware/dump978, file `sample-data.txt.gz`
  (renamed here).
- Licence: BSD-2-Clause (the dump978 repository's licence).
- Content: 1,143 dump978 raw UAT messages: 439 downlink, 704 uplink.
- Line format: `-<hex>;` (downlink) or `+<hex>;` (uplink), no timestamps,
  gzip-compressed. skycue-rawplay paces such files at 10 lines/s.
  First line: `-00a66ef135445d525a0c0519119021204800;`.
- sha256: `86248797f4334a134ccf4349dabf800a7054d698828b88838dc7950a99f9ae24`

## raw/stratux-uat-2015.log.gz

- Origin: https://github.com/cyoung/stratux, file
  `test-data/cyoung-09062015-noproblem-stratux-uat.log` at commit
  `1a0d1ca9e94d1c98ae1f4305e073fdd6b5a810be` (renamed here, content
  unchanged, compressed with `gzip -9n`); downloaded 2026-11-02.
- Licence: BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2015 Christopher Young (the stratux
  repository's `LICENSE` at that commit, full text below).
- Content: 22,556 lines: 11,276 UAT messages (7,516 uplink, all 432 bytes;
  3,760 downlink, 107 short of 18 bytes and 3,653 long of 34 bytes; none of
  a wrong length), each followed by a blank line, and 4 `START,<date>`
  session header lines. Two recording sessions: offsets 162.698 s to
  2507.803 s (8,125 messages, 2,345 s), then, after the header on line
  16,253, from 65.807 s again to 2205.878 s (3,151 messages, 2,140 s).
- Line format: `<ns>,<+|->HEX;[rs=N;]`: `<ns>` a nanosecond offset from an
  arbitrary start, then a dump978 raw line (`rs=` on 7,245 of them).
  skycue-rawplay strips the offset and paces by it; skycue-iqgen times
  frames by it. A `START` line or a backward offset begins a new session:
  both tools play the sessions in file order, never interleaved, each one
  1 s after the previous session's last message with its own spacing kept
  (skycued::StratuxClock). Here session 2 follows at 2346.105 s from the
  first message. Both skip and count the `START` lines.
  First line: `START,Wed Sep 2 04:23:37 +0000 UTC 2015`; first message:
  `162698355928,-0b2b4a513c417b8875f40d9610f227401105c4e6c4e6c40a32700300000000000000;rs=4;`.
- sha256: `53fc80938c55d777ef85929fbaef519a7ccfa41ecb37c6e23aa773daebe5d588`
  (the uncompressed log:
  `fd4b376c7d90fe92dd1f9d5f2f8d11a19deb81ea3dc68e9b6e10f091e33d73f5`)

## fisb/pireps.txt

- **What it is:** the 19 distinct PIREP texts skycue-fisb decodes from three
  captures, one per line (the decoder's newlines replaced by spaces), after a
  2-line `#` header; used by `tests/js/app_pure.test.js` for the PIREP `/OV`
  forms (id, id + `rrrddd`, `id rrrddd`, 4-character id, a route, free text).
- **Origin and licence, by line:**
  - lines 1-14: decoded from `raw/stratux-uat-2015.log.gz` (above),
    BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2015 Christopher Young; licence text in the
    `raw/stratux-uat-2015.log.gz` section of this file;
  - lines 15-17: decoded from `fisb/received-tg30.jsonl`, derived from
    fisb-decode's `tg30.978` (BSD-2-Clause Plus Patent,
    `fisb/LICENSE.fisb-decode`);
  - lines 18-19: decoded from `fisb/received-with-uplinks.jsonl`, derived
    from the dump978 sample `raw/uat-sample.txt.gz` (BSD-2-Clause).
- **How it is made** (from the repository root, with a staged skycue-fisb;
  the stratux log's `<ns>,` prefix is stripped first and `--ref-date` dates
  its untimestamped uplinks; the JSONL inputs carry their own times):

```bash
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
zcat skycue/tests/fixtures/raw/stratux-uat-2015.log.gz | sed -n 's/^[0-9][0-9]*,\([+-]\)/\1/p' > "$tmp/stratux.txt"
for f in "$tmp/stratux.txt" skycue/tests/fixtures/fisb/received-tg30.jsonl skycue/tests/fixtures/fisb/received-with-uplinks.jsonl; do
  build/stage/bin/skycue-fisb --json --ref-date 2015-09-02 "$f"
done | python3 -I -c '
import json, sys
seen = []
for line in sys.stdin:
    e = json.loads(line)
    if e.get("type") == "fisb_text" and e.get("kind") == "pirep" and e["text"] not in seen:
        seen.append(e["text"])
for t in seen:
    print(t.replace("\n", " "))
' > "$tmp/pireps.body"
{ printf '%s\n' '# Real PIREPs decoded by skycue-fisb: lines 1-14 from raw/stratux-uat-2015.log.gz (BSD-3-Clause,' \
    '# see tests/fixtures/README.md), 15-17 from fisb/received-tg30.jsonl, 18-19 from fisb/received-with-uplinks.jsonl.'; cat "$tmp/pireps.body"; } \
  > skycue/tests/fixtures/fisb/pireps.txt
grep -vc '^#' skycue/tests/fixtures/fisb/pireps.txt; rm -rf "$tmp"   # prints 19
```

- sha256: `56271e7acf2939e69e13a74f709bf5dbd3e2644604d9d7f28c6cfa508fef7d59`
